svg.text: End-to-End Operational Pipeline, Core Functional Modules & Relational Data Flows (16:9 Widescreen)
• Browses Bins • Places Orders • Tracks Hauls
• Stocks Manifests • AI Images • Dispatches Orders
• Onboards Staff • Controls Pricing • Draws Winners

• Atomic Order Insertion & Instant Stock Decrement
Output: Order #ID Generated → Enters Pending Queue
• Stock Manifest Ingestion & Liquidation Bin Allocation
• ✨ AI Smart Image Generator (Zero URL Dependency)
• Local File Upload Integration via Multer Storage
• Manager Dispatch Status Switcher & Order Audit
• Live Fulfillment Cards: Delivered, Pending, Shipped, Cancelled
• Admin Coupon Creation (Discount %, Start & End Dates)
• Automated Entry for Every Checkout Customer
• Public Winner Wall (/lucky-draw.html) & Admin Audit Log
• Friday Restock Alert Email Subscribers Management
CENTRAL PERSISTENCE LAYER: MySQL Relational Database (`liquidation_bin`)
Connection Pool Architecture (mysql2) • Normalized Schema • Foreign Key Cascades • ACID Compliant Transactions
